source_semantics.success_boundary: Delete returns successfully and ReloadAsync(false) completes against the authoritative Sites collection
source_semantics.failure_semantics: delete or authoritative reload failure remains visible failure and never fabricates success

laravel_adaptation.tenant_source: active server TenantContext plus server-advertised FrontendContext tenant slug
laravel_adaptation.ownership_lookup: unscoped Site lookup constrained by active tenant_id plus positive site primary key
laravel_adaptation.active_execution_guard: queued or running execution for the same active tenant and site rejects with 409
laravel_adaptation.persistence: transactional deletion followed by authoritative database absence verification before 204
laravel_adaptation.frontend_reconciliation: after 204, GET /api/tenants/{tenant}/sites is reread and the deleted ID must be absent before success is shown
laravel_adaptation.duplicate_submission: confirm/delete controls are disabled while the destructive request is pending
laravel_adaptation.csrf_session: apiRequest preserves same-origin credentials, XMLHttpRequest header, and page CSRF token
